notes.title: New Steam Update Available — What’s Coming Up
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We wanted to send a special thank you to everyone who has played Spray Paint Simulator since its launch last Thursday. We have been blown away by the support and thoughtful feedback you have shared with us. It means a lot to our tiny team to see so many of you jumping in and giving the game a go!

Through your feedback, we have identified some issues and are working diligently to address them. While we are still working on a few things, we have recently rolled out a few fixes in the latest update:
[list]
[*] Scaffolding not unlocking after the Bus fix
[*] Reduced paper/tape usage rate
[*] Some balancing fixes to the large nozzle's paint usage
[*] Improved medium nozzle for Sprayite 150 & Yopaint 3000
[*] Cash pick-ups are available in other game modes
[*] Autosave every 5 minutes
[*] Climbing boots fixed
[*] Fixed a bug swapping spray tools between passes
[/list]
You can check to see if you have updated to the most current version by checking to see if you're playing Build ID 18677495.

We have also added some additional launch options. The supported options are now: 

[list]
[*]difficulty=4
[/list]
Values of 0-5 are supported with 0 being the easiest and 5 being the game default

[list]
[*]60fps
[/list]
This should limit the framerate to a maximum of 60fps
[list]
[*] notimelapse
[/list]
This switches off the timelapse capture of your progress. If you are struggling with mouse jumps or frame glitches this might help sort it out.

The launch options are only really intended to be quick fixes. We'll work on implementing more robust solutions ASAP, launch options just allow us to get solutions to you much more quickly.

[h3]What we have coming up[/h3]

As we mentioned, there are still a few bug fixes that we’re working on which at the moment, are our top priority, but we also wanted to mention a few things we have in the forks for future updates. 

[b]Co-Op Multiplayer in Career Mode[/b]

We are happy to see that so many people are eager to play with friends in Career Mode. As a small team, we had to make some difficult decisions to make sure we provided a solid game at launch, and we wanted to makes sure that we did have some kind of multiplayer available since we know how much fun getting creative with friends can be. But we know this is only the beginning. Expanding co-op is one of our top priorities and we plan on improving it in future updates.

[b]The Cherry Picker[/b]

We’re glad that many people are enjoying this feature in the game, but realize that some improvements can be made. We are working on some that will enhance the experience, but these changes will take a little time to implement. So, please look forward to those in future updates.

Once again, we truly appreciate everyone who has taken the time to play and provide us with feedback. We are overwhelmed with the reception and we couldn’t be more grateful to you all!

If you have spotted anything or have suggestions, we would love to continute to hear from you. To make sure that nothing is missed, please feel free to submit any bugs or feedback to these forms:
[list]
[*] [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeEihvsfkjv3NoAT0QFYUBuBOMPYrVxY-JAbqIUseYa2JHw1A/viewform]Bug Report[/url]
[*] [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdZ3Ta43CVv1oIuQU-bo7uudN8BN_2mmxFnvKuYQLk6fGgvpg/viewform]Feedback[/url]
[/list]
With more things to come, be sure to drop the game a follow to keep up to date with the latest announcements! You can also follow us on [b][url=https://x.com/NorthStarVG]Twitter[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/northstarvgames/]Instagram[/url][/b],[b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@spraypaintsim]TikTok[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/WhitethornGames]Discord[/url][/b], and check out our official [b][url=https://www.northstarvideogames.com/]website[/url][/b]. 

Happy painting!
- Nick & Adam

notes.title: Spray Paint Simulator Release Date Announced

Hello friends!

We have some very exciting news to share with you today! [b]Spray Paint Simulator is launching on Steam on May 29! [/b]

[previewyoutube=xUy4mcr2qgg;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re so excited to be able to share Spray Paint Simulator with you very soon. The support we’ve received from players during development has been wonderful. Your feedback on social media and Steam since the time of our game’s announcement has been invaluable. We’ve loved to see how you’ve taken to the game and you’ve all given us excellent thoughts on how we can make Spray Paint Simulator the best it can be for launch. In the meantime, we know you’re eager to jump in, so we’ve given the demo a small update. We’ve added some polish to make it more inline with the final game, smoothed out many of the bugs, and updated some of the language support.

notes.title: Introducing ZACH-BOT 1 — The Giant Robot
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We’re back again with a little more insight into what you’ll get to experience in [b]Spray Paint Simulator[/b] when it launches this May! Today, we’d like to introduce you to one of the most unique jobs you’ll get to take on during your journey to become the best painter Spatterville has ever seen — a giant robot!

Yes, you read that correctly — you’ll get to paint a giant robot!

Tech genius and eccentric billionaire inventor, Zach, has finally achieved the unthinkable — his very own giant robot! While the design itself is a brilliant masterpiece, Zach needs your painting expertise to bring his vision to fruition. However, this is a massive job, so you’ll need to bring all the right tools with you (such as a recently restored cherry picker, perhaps?) and utilize all the techniques you’ve learned throughout your career. With a fresh coat of paint, the gargantuan ZACH-BOT 1 will be perfect, PERFECT! All that’s left is for the genius inventor to figure out just what to do with it…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193365/b24c400a0c0dd1ca39ecbd3d720e6f9bee56ce3c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193365/ee24547c30a8314ff08078fe84bb5f06a78ac9b9.png[/img]
[i]Looking pretty spiffy, ZACH-BOT![/i]

[b][h3]Eager to play the game? We’d love for you to check out the demo![/h3][/b]
We want to make sure that Spray Paint Simulator is the best it can be when it launches this May, so your feedback is invaluable. notes.title: Introducing the Cherry Picker — Take on Big Jobs with Ease!
notes.content:
Hello again, friends!

We’re very excited about the upcoming launch of [b]Spray Paint Simulator[/b] this May, so we thought this would be a good opportunity to talk about some of the things in store for players! Today, we’re going to look at one of the more pivotal jobs you’ll need to take on during your journey to becoming the best painter the town of Spatterville has ever seen — the handy [b]cherry picker[/b]!

The ever-helpful Vincent is back again to give you a hand in growing your spray painting business and helping you be the best in Spatterville by offering you free access to a neglected cherry picker — an essential tool for some of the biggest jobs in the game. But first, it’s going to need a little love to get it back on its feet. Use your expertise to give this bad boy a fresh coat of paint, and you’ll be able to tackle any job that comes your way!

[b]Have a look at the cherry picker below:[/b]

notes.title: Check Out Spray Paint Simulator During Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello Friends!

We're very excited to share that[b] Spray Paint Simulator will be part of Steam Next Fest 2025 - February Edition![/b] During the event, we invite you to try out our new demo, optimized to provide you with an incredibly relaxing and satisfying gameplay experience!

In the new demo — packed with more content than ever — we've removed the time limit to make it more reflective of the experience of the final game. You'll also get to paint a new level in career mode, Tony’s kitchen! Tony needs the place spiffed up before his son’s birthday party and needs your help to take it from drab to fab!

You'll also get to try out the first look at multiplayer in Free Spray Mode! Jump in with a friend online and go wild as you paint the town — or each other — together!

[b] Join Us For A Special Live Stream! [/b]

On Thursday, February 27, at 1 PM Eastern / 11 AM Pacific, we're hosting a stream where we'll talk a little bit about the game's development and show off some new gameplay! We hope you can join us!

[b]We want to hear from you![/b]

We want to make sure that Spray Paint Simulator is the best that it can be when it launches this year, so your feedback is invaluable. Once you’ve had a chance to try the demo, you are welcome to share your feedback with us by filling out our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeSRFVWnJZPG5OXsXBGFiCaz4lCCi36AplTZc45lEpg1qVBaA/viewform]feedback form[/url]. We’re thrilled to share Spray Paint Simulator, and we hope you enjoy your time with the demo during Steam Next Fest! We have a lot more in store for you over the next few months, so please make sure to drop the game a wishlist! 

You can also follow us on [url=https://x.com/NorthStarVG]Twitter[/url], [url=https://x.com/NorthStarVG]Instagram[/url], [url=https://x.com/NorthStarVG]TikTok[/url], and [url=https://discord.com/invite/WhitethornGames]Discord[/url], and check out our official [url=https://www.northstarvideogames.com/]website[/url].

notes.title: First Demo for Spray Paint Simulator Live Now
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We’re very excited to share that the [b]first demo for Spray Paint Simulator is now available for you to play![/b] We also revealed a new trailer during The MIX Fall Showcase — in case you missed it, you can watch it below:

[previewyoutube=K7PbnQQTLNA;full][/previewyoutube]
During the demo, you’ll be given your first job at the start of your career to become the best painter the town of Spatterville has ever seen! Start by purchasing your supplies, prepping the area, selecting the client’s desired colour, and then painting to perfection! Finally, remove the tape and paper for a satisfying reveal of a job well done! And don’t forget to grab your radio — a job isn’t any fun without some tunes! And if you colour outside the lines a bit, that’s no problem — the people of Spatterville are quite forgiving if there’s a little extra paint on the ground, or the grass, or their house… As progress won't be saved during this first demo, a little mess made here and there won't be of any matter!

But if you really want to get wild, then you’re in for a treat — check out Free Spray mode during the demo! With an array of lovely colours unlocked, you can create a rainbow world and paint anything you can reach! If you want a break, go exploring through the area — on foot or with the help of some scaffolding and ladders — to uncover some fun hidden secrets. 

[h3][b]We want to hear from you![/b][/h3]

We want to make sure that Spray Paint Simulator is the best that it can be when it launches next year, so your feedback is invaluable. Once you’ve had a chance to try the demo, you are welcome to share your feedback with us by filling out our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeSRFVWnJZPG5OXsXBGFiCaz4lCCi36AplTZc45lEpg1qVBaA/viewform]feedback form[/url]. And if you happen to find a bug while you’re playing, you can quickly let us know [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe0OA3qD1u5pksXWnSTm5W5y20lr38ObReMiWn8qVeen3-tpg/viewform]here[/url]. 

[h3][b]CARtwork Contest![/b][/h3]

To celebrate the release of the demo, we thought it would be fun to hold a little artwork competition, as we would love to see the creativity you unleash while you play. 

[b]To enter:[/b]
[list]
[*] Share a screenshot of your painted car from the demo and tag @northstarvg and @whitethorngames on Twitter, Bluesky, or Instagram OR via the Whitethorn Games Spray Paint Simulator channel on Discord
[*] Let your creativity shine, but please, no NSFW content, we’re family-friendly here
[*] Enter as many times as you like between November 21-December 6
[*] Winners will be announced on December 9 and will receive a code for the game!
[/list]
Good luck, and may the best CARtwork win!

We’re thrilled to share Spray Paint Simulator and we hope you enjoy your time with the demo! We have a lot more in store for you over the next few months, so please make sure to drop the game a wishlist.
